codeReview.summary: This feature is a verification-only pass confirming all M1+M2+M3 systems work together. The commit (5256103) contains substantive implementation work from prior features (validation-view assertions, widget assertion counts, report assertion/evidence sections, scrutiny findings display, evidence preservation on abort). The worker ran all three verification commands (bun test, tsc --noEmit, biome check) and confirmed 2280 tests pass, zero TypeScript errors, zero Biome diagnostics. The worker also verified that scrutiny reviewer receives worker handoff data via the VAL-CROSS-009 test. No new code was written for this feature — it was purely a validation gate. The code in commit 5256103 (from prior features) is well-structured: renderValidationView correctly handles optional assertions/scrutiny panels with dynamic height allocation, buildAssertionLines properly truncates long output at 80 chars, report.ts renderAssertionsSection caps output summaries at 200 chars, and the evidence preservation test confirms abort does not delete evidence files. All functions follow project conventions (named exports, no comments, early returns, TypeBox schemas, const usage).

sharedStateObservations.observation: The renderValidationView function signature has grown to 9 positional parameters (milestoneName, commands, hasFailed, width, style, height, scrollOffset, assertions, scrutinyReport). While not a bug, this is approaching the point where an options object would improve readability and maintainability. AGENTS.md does not mention a threshold for function parameter count.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The type name 'AssertionResultData' contains a typo — 'Asserion' instead of 'Assertion'. This is consistent across the codebase (types.ts, report.ts, validation-view.ts, widget.ts, tests) so it's not a mismatch, but it's a naming inconsistency with standard English spelling that could confuse future contributors.
